ambiguous_family_mapping.reason: An exposed catalog identity must resolve to one reviewed family rule before 0.7.0 can claim deterministic enrichment.

ambiguous_source_variant_mapping.reason: An exposed source variant must resolve to one reviewed exact-source rule before 0.7.0 can claim deterministic variant semantics.

missing_citation.reason: Reviewed enrichment for an exposed item must retain authoritative source provenance and citations.

missing_rule_definition.reason: A currently exposed catalog identity remains part of the 0.7.0 reconciliation surface until its absence is explicitly overridden as an accepted scope decision.

stale_citation_source.reason: A citation tied to an older rules revision must be reviewed against the current publication before release.

unresolved_related_item_link.reason: A reviewed relation from exposed enrichment must resolve to its intended application or supporting rules identity.

unresolved_surface_rule.reason: Rules surfaced through the application must resolve back to the selected rules snapshot so coverage is reproducible.

unreviewed_rule.reason: Draft or otherwise unreviewed contributions cannot satisfy the 0.7.0 reviewed-enrichment gate.

missing_rule_definition.reason: Complete Weapon rule-definition coverage belongs to the 1.0 data-completeness gate. During 0.10 stabilization, missing Weapon definitions remain tracked but do not block release; other Weapon gap codes retain their normal classifications.

supportingIdentity.reason: The related rules identity supports an exposed item but does not require its own standalone browser surface for 0.7.0.

overrides.reason: Commlink is owned by the separately versioned Reinforcements Extra planned for the 1.0 completeness gate, so its missing definition is intentionally deferred from 0.10.
